_comment: STUBBED policy administration system. In production the gate reads these fields over an API from the carrier's policy and claims systems. ASSUMPTION: real-time programmatic access exists. If a carrier's policy system is batch-only, the gate cannot run synchronously and the whole flow becomes asynchronous — a deployment discovery, not a design change.

CLM-1001._scenario: Clean path, real photographs. Front corner damage on a panel carrying no sensors. Expect: verify tier.

CLM-1002._scenario: Insufficient evidence. Expect: a specific re-request, then escalation at the attempt cap. Upload your own photos here to see the loop resolve.

CLM-1003._scenario: The surprise. Rear bumper scuff on a sensor-equipped sedan — looks trivially automatable, is not. Expect: ADAS penalty drops it to starting_point.

CLM-1004._scenario: Authenticity flag. Photo capture time predates the reported loss. Expect: flagged, confidence reduced, routed for review. NOT denied.

CLM-1005._scenario: Tier 1 exclusion: injury reported. Expect: not processed.

CLM-1006._scenario: Tier 1 exclusion: policy not in force at loss date. Expect: not processed, no compute spent.
